name: chat
description: A messaging app: a searchable, filterable conversation list (the list recipe in single-select listbox mode — avatar, name, last-message preview, time, unread badge) beside the open conversation (a header with avatar, name and presence; a chat-thread of chat-message bubbles with a typing indicator; the composer). Two panes from the md breakpoint, one at a time with a back button below it. Wired entirely by one l-data scope and bindings — selecting a conversation shows its thread and clears its unread count, sending appends an outgoing bubble through a keyed l-for and updates the preview — with no custom JavaScript.

sidebar.description: The conversation column. aria-labelledby its title, and bind :data-state to active while nothing is open (active === null), inactive otherwise.

sidebar-header.description: Title row of the conversation column.

sidebar-title.description: 'Chats'. Give it an id for the sidebar's aria-labelledby.

sidebar-actions.description: Icon buttons beside the title (new chat, menu), each a [data-part='action'].

search.description: Search well: an aria-hidden search icon and an <input type='search'> with an aria-label, bound with l-model. The well draws the focus ring.

filters.description: role='group' row of filter toggles (All / Unread / Groups).

filter.description: One filter: a toggle button whose aria-pressed is bound to the active filter.

main.description: The open conversation's column: one [data-part='conversation'] per chat, the empty state, and the shared composer. Bind :data-state to active while a chat is open.

conversation.description: One chat: its header and its chat-thread, shown with :hidden='active !== {id}'. Every authored conversation but the initially open one also carries a static hidden attribute as the pre-boot guard.

header.description: The conversation header: back, peer avatar, peer-info and actions.

back.description: Back to the list (@click='active = null'), with an aria-label. Shown only below the md breakpoint, where one pane is on screen at a time.

peer.description: aria-hidden wrapper for the chat's avatar (a person, or a group picture).

peer-info.description: Stacks the chat's name over its presence line.

peer-name.description: The chat's name, as a heading; its id names the chat-thread (aria-labelledby).

presence.description: 'online', 'last seen today at 07:58', the members of a group, or — with data-state='typing' — 'typing…' in the accent.

actions.description: Header icon buttons (video, voice, search), each a [data-part='action'] with an aria-label.

action.description: A round icon button in the sidebar header or the conversation header. Always a real button with an aria-label.

empty.description: What the main column shows from md up when nothing is open (:hidden='active !== null'): an illustration, a heading and a line of help.

active.description: The pane worth showing: the list while nothing is open, the conversation once one is. From md up both panes show regardless.

inactive.description: The other pane. Below the md floor (48rem) it is display:none — that IS the responsive collapse.

typing.description: The presence line says the peer is typing, in the accent.

--chat-height.description: Block size of the whole app (custom property). It needs one so the thread scrolls inside it — 100dvh for a full-screen chat.

--chat-sidebar-width.description: Widest the conversation column grows from md up (custom property); it never shrinks below 17rem.

keyboard.Tab: search → filters → the conversation list (one tab stop) → the open conversation's header buttons → its message log → the controls in its messages → the composer
keyboard.ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End in the: move between conversations (list recipe, single-select listbox)
keyboard.Printable characters in the list: type-ahead to a conversation by name
keyboard.Enter in the composer: send; Shift+Enter for a new line (composer recipe)

notes: Selection is the listbox's aria-selected, bound to the l-data `active` id in both directions: the list's faqir:select sets it, and the back button clears it, which deselects the option.
Each chat-thread is a role='log' named by its conversation's heading, so a sent or arriving message is announced politely without moving focus; the composer keeps focus after a send.
The unread badge reads its count plus a visually hidden 'unread', so the option's name is 'Maya Chen, Meet at the bakery at 8?, 09:24, 2 unread'.
Search and filters hide options with the hidden attribute; the list controller leaves hidden options out of focus, type-ahead and range selection.
The one-pane collapse is CSS keyed on each pane's data-state; nothing is removed from the DOM, so the open thread keeps its scroll position across back and forth.

data_shape.note: What an agent binds where. The pattern owns its state in one l-data scope on the root; every binding sits BELOW the root.

scope.active: string | null — the id of the open conversation. null opens nothing (the list on a phone, the empty state from md up).
scope.unread: { [id]: number } — the badge per conversation; open(id) zeroes it.
scope.sent: { [id]: Array<{ id, text, files, time }> } — what this session sent, rendered after the authored messages by a keyed l-for.
scope.last / time: { [id]: string } — the preview line and time each option shows; send() updates both.
scope.query / filter: the search text (l-model) and the active filter ('all' | 'unread' | 'groups'); show(id) combines them for each option's :hidden.

events.faqir:send (composer): @faqir:send="send($event.detail)" on the composer root; detail is { text, files }

notes: Slot ownership: a data-part belongs to its nearest data-ui ancestor. The rows are the list's items, the bubbles' parts are chat-message's, the field and send button are the composer's — the chat pattern owns only its panes, headers, search, filters and the empty state.
The list's options carry no controls (a listbox option is one control); per-chat actions live in the conversation header.
The composer is shared by every conversation: send() appends to whichever conversation is active, and the textarea's aria-label is bound to its name.

Below md the inactive pane is display:none and nothing re-renders, so switching back and forth keeps each thread's scroll position — and a column-reverse chat-thread opens on its newest message by itself.
